events.title: Demo Adjusted Based on Feedback!

events.title: Skateboard Knight Demo released today!
events.summary: Ahead of Steam Next Fest, the latest demo version of Skateboard Knight has been released today! In this demo, the game system has been significantly improved from the previous version. You can enjoy not only exhilarating action, but also various permanent upgrades such as leveling up Skateboard Knight and weapon crafting. events.title: Demo showcase confirmed for TGS2026!
events.summary: Easy to pick up yet deeply satisfying action RPG-style roguelite Skateboard Knight has been confirmed for a demo showcase at TGS2026! In the demo version, you can play through the game's early stages! Grow your Skateboard Knight and aim to take on boss battles and unlock further stages! events.title: Skateboard Knight to be Published by PLAYISM!
events.summary: Casually save the world on a skateboard! PLAYISM is proud to announce that we will be publishing Skateboard Knight, the action RPG-esque roguelite by Maroru Games! The controls are simple: just move up and down to pick a lane. Horizontal movement and attacks are all automatic! Please wishlist the game and look forward to future announcements for this laid back but surprisingly deep action RPG-esque roguelite! We also have a demo here on Steam, so please try it out! https://store.steampowered.com
